beats.text: Make the pool: train Sept–June in your district

script: There's a tryout most Florida players never hear about. It's called ODP, the Olympic Development Program. This year, Florida's tryouts ran in August, fifty dollars per location. Make the pool, and you train with top players in your district from September all the way to June. Follow so you don't miss next year's.
caption:
The tryout most Florida players miss: ODP 👀

ODP is the Olympic Development Program, run in Florida by FYSA. For 2026/27, tryouts ran in August at locations around the state ($50 per player, per location). Selected players train in their district pool from September 2026 through June 2027.

Missed it? Save this and follow Cancha so you catch the 2027 tryouts. Details: fysa.com/odp

Pathway 101 is our series on how Florida players move up. Next: when college coaches can actually contact you.
